ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the vertical axis is labeled e/V, and the horizontal axis is labeled t/s. The maximum value of the sinusoidal curve is marked at +100√2 V, and the minimum value is marked at -100√2 V. The curve starts from zero and rises at t=0, crosses zero again and goes downward at t=0.02 s, crosses zero again and goes upward at t=0.04 s, returning to the zero point with the same phase. Reasoning: From the figure, the peak value of the electromotive force can be read as Em=100√2 V. The effective value of sinusoidal alternating current is E=Em/√2=100 V. Adjacent zero points with the same phase from 0 to 0.04 s correspond to one complete period, so the rotation period of the coil is T=0.04 s. The angular velocity is ω=2π/T=2π/0.04=50π rad/s.
